status.ok: Realised: the carried + invalid + unwitnessed-exit shares are at most 5 %.

status.unavailable: No return: too little return data this week to measure it.
status.no_holdings: No holdings: no book could be formed this week; the failed constraint is named.
status.shares_not_recorded: The run did not record the weight shares; the week is not classified.
status.return_not_yet_realised: Next week's candidates, formed at the entry close: not held yet, so there is no return (return not yet realised).
